page_title: EMP 1-0 SAL | Empoli v Salernitana 27/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Antonio Rapuano has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Empoli was in an offside position.
90+5' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Antonio Rapuano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Matteo Lovato (Salernitana).
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.
87' POST! Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
86' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
83' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Domagoj Bradaric as he is replaced by Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana).
82' Razvan Marin (Empoli) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
80' Flavius Daniliuc (Salernitana) makes a rough challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but Guillermo Ochoa comes off his line to gather the ball.
78' The resulting set piece from Empoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' It looked like the long-range shot by Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) for Tommaso Baldanzi.
74' Aurelio Andreazzoli has decided to substitute Jacopo Fazzini and he is replaced by Razvan Marin (Empoli).
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) is coming onto the pitch as Stiven Shpendi cannot continue after picking up an injury.
71' The flag is raised and Stiven Shpendi (Empoli) is offside again, not for the first time today.
67' The linesman signals that Stiven Shpendi (Empoli) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
67' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper, but his effort is straight at Guillermo Ochoa, who is alert and makes an easy save to deny him.
67' An attempted cross from Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) is cleared.
66' Stiven Shpendi (Empoli) commits a rough challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) will replace Pasquale Mazzocchi.
64' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) is adjudged offside.
64' Stiven Shpendi (Empoli) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Guillermo Ochoa makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
61' The game is interrupted now, Liberato Cacace (Empoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
58' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Stiven Shpendi (Empoli) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
53' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
52' None of the Empoli players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) comes off for Emil Bohinen.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) is replaced by Erik Botheim.
46' Paulo Sousa has made a change at the break. Flavius Daniliuc has come on in place of Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+6' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Antonio Rapuano with no other option than to blow for a foul.
45+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Empoli comes to nothing.
45+4' The corner is swung in but Salernitana can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+4' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) takes a short corner kick.
45+1' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' A player from Empoli commits a rough challenge. Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
40' Stiven Shpendi (Empoli) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for an infringement.
39' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
37' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

34' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Matteo Cancellieri, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli), who beats Guillermo Ochoa with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
30' Empoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
28' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
27' Flag up against Stiven Shpendi (Empoli). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
24' What was Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
23' Empoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
22' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Salernitana due to an offside in the build-up play.
21' Wait! Referee Antonio Rapuano has indicated he is going to review the Salernitana goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
20' Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) gets on the scoresheet after converting his one-on-one chance with a cheeky nutmeg through the legs of the goalkeeper!
19' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
19' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal and forces the goalkeeper to make a great save. Empoli earn a corner.
19' Empoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

18' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Guillermo Ochoa was alert and the score remains the same. The ball goes out for a corner. Empoli can continue in their attacking effort.
18' The referee blows his whistle as Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) was too aggressive in his challenge.
17' Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Tyronne Ebuehi replaces him.
15' Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
14' The foul by Youssef Maleh (Empoli) was seen by Antonio Rapuano who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
13' Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
11' Giuseppe Pezzella is substituted due to injury. Aurelio Andreazzoli gives a chance to Liberato Cacace (Empoli).
9' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
9' Poor challenge! Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) is penalised for tripping and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle.
5' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
4' Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
2' Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul after Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Empoli will have the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
